name: card_fonts_r1
title: Card fonts, round 1
intro: The same eight cards in each pairing, trimmed, at 300 dpi: print a sheet at 300 dpi for true size. Body text stays at the size each card prints today (default 7.5 pt) in every sheet. Below 7.5 pt: how many of the 158 player cards would need a smaller body size in that font, tried on the real text of the whole set; 83 print smaller today, because today's sizing is a character-count estimate. Over the plate: titles wider than their banner on one line. Figures (cost, insight, numbers on icon lines) stay Saira Condensed in every sheet. All serif sets titles at 13.5 pt, not 15: at 15 pt, 16 titles were over the plate. The threat and Discord card have no frame yet, so they show the viewer's plain face.
